slides.title: The morning after hosting: the clean-up order that saves the day
Trash first
slides.body: One bag, one lap of the house. Seeing empty surfaces fast makes the next steps easier.

slides.title: Load the dishwasher, start it
slides.body: Whatever fits goes in. Hand-wash nothing yet. The machine works while you move on.

slides.title: Soak the big pans
slides.body: Hot water and soap, then walk away. Ten minutes later they wipe clean.

slides.title: Leftovers into clear containers
slides.body: Label with the day. If you can see it, it gets eaten.

slides.title: Stop at 15 minutes
slides.body: Set a timer. When it rings, rest. The rest can be a second round after lunch.

slides.title: A clean-up plan you can do tired is better than one you can't start.
Want more plans made for tired brains?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
